Date: 2027-01-20T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Capacity needs & MAP kickoff - Crestline POC

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers looked promising. We are planning a 12-week POC that will validate an internal claims-processing feature using a ~4k token context and multimodal attachments. Our success criteria are: 95th pct latency < 200ms for short responses, end-to-end throughput ~60 qps during peak batch runs, and overnight batch embedding throughput for nightly reconciliation.

We want to discuss a Mutual Action Plan that includes reserved capacity for Dedicated or a Private VPC deployment. Target start for reserved capacity is the week of Mar 15 (we're flexible by ±2 weeks), but procurement lead time and SOC2 evidence are gating factors on our side. Can you propose an evaluation plan (staging acceptance tests + perf/quality thresholds) and a tentative commit schedule for GPU pool sizing?

Attaching a two-paragraph summary of workloads and current infra constraints (attached as "crestline-workload-summary.docx" in our internal doc). Happy to sync this week — Tuesday/Wednesday mornings PST preferred.

Simon
Product Lead — Crestline AI

Simon — thanks for the clear brief. I've drafted a one-page MAP and an initial GPU pool sizing spreadsheet (attached: crestline_map_v1.pdf, gpu_pool_sizing_v2.csv). High-level proposal here:

- Evaluation runway (2 weeks): staging perf and quality gates (see MAP).
- Pilot tranche (4 GPUs equivalent): latency/throughput sanity checks + KV cache warm-up.
- Ramp tranche (additional 12 GPUs equivalent): sustained peak throughput testing and overnight batch window.
- Acceptance: signed performance sign-off + runbook handover.

Key lead times to note: Dedicated pools on our hosted offering typically require 6–8 weeks from signed commitment to full capacity (hardware allocation + provisioning). Private VPC/on‑prem options add procurement and network validation, so plan for 10–12 weeks end‑to‑end. We'll include staging alternatives (short-term burst capacity) to hit your Mar 15 target if procurement slips.

Can you confirm the acceptance metrics and whether the POC requires VPC isolation? If procurement will push the timeline, we can propose a 2-week gated trial on Hosted+Dedicated burst to validate your core success criteria while contracts finish.

I've cc'd Karthik for sizing and Laura for commercial cadence. I've also attached a SOC2 evidence checklist we typically provide to procurement (soc2_evidence_request.xlsx).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm isolation requirement and procurement timeline by EOD Fri 1/22.
2) We'll lock an initial MAP with milestone dates and DocuSign link.
3) Karthik will schedule an onboarding tech check in the week prior to staging.

Thanks — available Tues/Wed morning as well.

— Marissa

On Thu, Jan 20, 2027 at 9:15 AM Simon Liu <simon.liu@crestline.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers looked promising.

Simon / team — quick technical notes to complement Marissa's plan:

- Sizing assumptions: your described 4k token context with multimodal inputs maps to ~1.6x compute per request vs. a 2k-token baseline. For the pilot, 4 A100-equivalent slots (or 8x q8_0 quantized nodes depending on model choice) should be enough for functional validation. For the ramp, target 12 A100-equivalents (or 24 q8_0 nodes) to sustain 60 qps with headroom and batching. See attached gpu_pool_sizing_v2.csv for modeled throughput.
- Lead-time delta: Hosted Dedicated reservation (in-region) = 6–8 weeks. Private VPC adds 4–6 weeks for networking and customer-side firewall reviews; on‑prem adds another procurement window (hardware delivery typically 10–14 weeks).
- Acceptance tests (staging): 95th pct latency < target; KV cache warm-up behavioral checks; model output regression on 200-shot eval prompt set; end-to-end batch window completion within scheduled downtime.
- Contingency: recommend a fallback model variant (smaller quantized checkpoint) pinned in the MAP for degraded-capacity operation and a routing policy that drops to the cheaper tier automatically if Dedicated pool saturation > 80%.

I can run a short perf sim with your sample payloads once we get the POC data set. I'll block 60m next Tue for the tech check if that works.

— Karthik
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
